summary.text: Corey Zimmerman is the Republican candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 26, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Eleanor Chavez (D).
A chaplain, he says he is running on faith, family and freedom, public safety and fiscal responsibility.

paragraphs.text: Zimmerman graduated from Maplewood Academy and earned a graduate degree from Andrews University in 2010, and his career experience includes working as a chaplain.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a board-certified chaplain and executive director of a Christian nonprofit organization, with a Master of Divinity and years of experience serving families in hospice and ministry.

In the same survey, Zimmerman called himself a conservative Christian Republican and listed his key messages as faith, family and freedom; safer communities and stronger families; and economic opportunity and fiscal responsibility.
He named life and family, public safety, school choice and local control in education, rebuilding the state's healthcare system, and lower taxes and regulations among his policy priorities.
